about.body: Fixes the layout and case of text you just typed. You set the boundary: the first press takes the last word, the second takes everything you typed.
crash.body: Something happened that the app did not anticipate. Hotkeys may have stopped working — please restart it.
crash.hint: If this keeps happening, send a report: it arrives with the error description, so we do not have to guess.
crash.title: oops crashed unexpectedly
feedback.browserFailed: Could not open the browser. Write manually: {0}
feedback.hint.empty: Describe it in your own words — the app and Windows versions are filled in automatically.
feedback.hint.ready: A GitHub page will open with the text already filled in — you just press Submit. A GitHub account is required.
feedback.hint.required: Write a couple of words first about what happened or what is missing.
feedback.title: Something wrong, or an idea?
feedback.window.title: Feedback
hook.failed.body: Hotkeys cannot work without it, so the app will not start.
hook.failed.hint: Usually another app with global hotkeys is in the way (Punto Switcher, a layout manager, an anti-cheat). Close it and try again.
hook.failed.title: Could not capture the keyboard
hotkey.clash.body: Layout and case cannot share one combination: only the first will fire, the second stays silent without a single sign.
hotkey.clash.hint: Assign different ones — for example Ctrl + Win for layout and Alt + Win for case.
hotkey.clash.title: Hotkeys are identical
hotkey.translate.hint: RU → EN and back, on this machine
model.err.checksumMismatch: The checksum of “{0}” does not match the expected one. The file is damaged or was tampered with — it has been deleted.
model.err.noChecksum: No checksum is defined for “{0}” — it must not be downloaded.
model.err.untrustedUrl: “{0}” is offered from an untrusted address.
models.failed.body: The download was interrupted. What arrived is kept — the next attempt resumes from the same place.
models.failed.hint: Check your connection and press “Download” again.
models.failed.title: Could not download the models
probe.matchCase: Matches the case hotkey — it will fire.
probe.matchLayout: Matches the layout hotkey — it will fire.
probe.noMatch: Does not match any assigned combination.
probe.prompt: Press a combination — whatever actually reached oops shows up here.
record.altShift: Alt+Shift is taken by Windows (layout switching). Pick another one.
record.hint: Press a combination and release the keys. Modifiers alone work (Ctrl + Alt + Win), so does a regular key (Ctrl + Alt + X). Esc cancels.
record.hookFailed: Could not capture the keyboard. Close this window and try again.
record.title: New combination
running.body: The app is running right now — it just has no window.
running.hint: Look for the icon in the tray, near the clock. Double-click it to open settings.
running.title: oops is already running
save.failed.body: Your changes apply right now, but the app will revert to the previous ones after a restart.
save.failed.hint:
Check that this folder is writable:
{0}
save.failed.title: Settings were not saved
settings.autostart.hint: Otherwise you will have to launch it by hand after a reboot
settings.autoupdate.hint: Once a day; we tell you about a new version, installing it is your call
settings.enabled.hint: Turns all hotkeys on and off
settings.expand.hint: Press again in time and the whole text is fixed; miss it and you get the last word again
settings.forget.hint: After a pause the hotkey works with new text instead of the old one
settings.language.hint: “Auto” follows Windows. Applies immediately, no restart needed
settings.slowTyping: Type slowly, one character at a time
settings.slowTyping.hint: Turn this on if text arrives with missing characters in some app
settings.subtitle: Fixes the layout and case of text you just typed. You set the boundary: each next press of the hotkey captures one more word.
settings.translation.absent: Models are not downloaded yet. This needs {0} MB and a little time.
settings.translation.body: Translates what you typed, or the selection, right in the input field. Works offline: the models live on your machine and no text is sent anywhere.
settings.translation.ready: Models are downloaded — translation is ready.
settings.translation.title: TRANSLATION
settings.unreadable.body: The settings file is damaged, so the app started with defaults.
settings.unreadable.hint:
Check your hotkeys in settings — you may need to set them again.
File: {0}
settings.unreadable.title: Settings could not be read
settings.voice.absent: The model is not downloaded yet. This needs {0} MB and a noticeable while.
settings.voice.body: Press the hotkey and speak; press it again and what you said is typed into the active field. Recognition runs on your machine — the audio is never sent anywhere and never written to disk.
settings.voice.ready: The model is downloaded — voice input is ready.
settings.voice.title: VOICE INPUT
translate.err.noModel: The translation model is not downloaded.
translate.failed.body: The translation engine could not process the text.
translate.failed.hint: Try again. If it keeps happening, remove and download the models again in settings.
translate.failed.title: Could not translate
translate.models.body: Translation needs its models — about {0} MB. They are downloaded once and then work offline.
translate.models.title: Translation is not available yet
update.err.checksumMismatch: The installer checksum does not match the published one. The file is damaged or was tampered with — it must not be run.
update.err.noChecksum: SHA256SUMS.txt in the release has no checksum for the installer.
update.err.noInstaller: The release has no installer file.
update.err.tooBig: The installer file is suspiciously large.
update.error.body: Something went wrong while contacting GitHub.
update.error.hint: You can download a new version manually here: {0}
update.failed.body: GitHub did not answer. Usually that is the internet or a temporary glitch on their side.
update.failed.hint: The app keeps working; you can download a new version manually from the releases page: {0}
update.failed.title: Could not check for updates
update.latest.title: You are up to date
update.none.body: No releases have been published in the repository yet.
update.none.title: No updates
update.unavailable.body: GitHub says there is no such repository. Usually that means it is private or was renamed.
update.unavailable.hint: While that is the case nobody can check for updates — or download from {0}
update.unavailable.title: Repository unavailable
update.window.title: Update
voice.err.noModel: The speech recognition model is not downloaded.
voice.failed.body: The microphone or the recogniser failed.
voice.failed.hint: Check that a microphone is connected and allowed in Windows privacy settings.
voice.failed.title: Could not recognise speech
voice.models.body: Speech recognition needs its model — about {0} MB. It is downloaded once and then works offline.
voice.models.title: Voice input is not available yet
welcome.example.second: 2nd press:    проверка того как это работает
welcome.hotkeys.subtitle: A combination can be modifiers only (Ctrl + Win) or include a regular key, for example Ctrl + Alt + X. All of it can be changed later in settings.
welcome.hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
welcome.how.clipboard: Fixed text is typed by emulating the keyboard and never reaches the clipboard — your Win+V history stays clean.
welcome.how.p1: The app does not guess where you slipped into the wrong layout — you set the boundary by how many times you press the hotkey:
welcome.how.p2: The first press fixes the last word, the second fixes everything you typed. The presses must follow each other within a couple of seconds.
welcome.how.selection: If text is selected with the mouse, the hotkey converts the whole selection.
welcome.intro.subtitle: Fixes the layout and case of text you just typed. Works in every Windows app.
welcome.note.altShift: Alt + Shift cannot be assigned: Windows keeps that combination for layout switching, so it never reaches the app.
welcome.note.tray: The app lives in the tray. Double-click the icon to open settings.
welcome.window.title: Welcome to oops
